blocks.html:
Screen Printing for Woodland Park's Mountain Community

Sitting at 8,465 feet on the western slope of Pikes Peak, Woodland Park is Teller County's largest town — about 20,000 residents who chose mountain living without sacrificing access to Colorado Springs 20 miles down Ute Pass. The community blends ranchers, outdoor recreation businesses, Colorado Springs commuters, and residents from Divide and Florissant. Custom apparel here ranges from branded fleece for guide operations to screen-printed tees for annual community events.

Woodland Park School District RE-2 serves students from Woodland Park through Divide and Florissant, and the Woodland Park Panthers compete across multiple sports with strong community support. Charis Bible College, based in Woodland Park, also draws a community of students and families who need custom gear for events, missions, and ministries. We take orders online and ship directly up the pass — no need to make the drive to Colorado Springs.

Mountain community

Custom screen printing and DTF for businesses, outfitters, and events throughout the Ute Pass corridor.

Woodland Park Panthers

Spirit wear and team apparel for RE-2 athletics and school community events.

Order online, ship up the pass

No drive required — we handle it from our Colorado Springs shop and get it to you fast.
